question: The highest peak of Arunachal Pradesh state is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mount Kangto**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Kangto **also known as **Kanggardo Rize **is the highest peak in **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• It is **7090 metres high and lies in the East Kameng district **of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• It is a part of the **Eastern Himalayan range which** lies on the** border of India and China.**
 
• It occupies **32nd place in the list of mountains of India heightwise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **K2** is the second-highest mountain on Earth. It lies in the Karakoram range,** partially in the Gilgit-Baltistan region of Pakistan-administered Kashmir and partially in a China-administered territory of the Kashmir region**
 
• It lies in the Karakoram range of the Himalayas.
 
• Its height is **8611metres**.
 
• **Mt. Everest** is the **highest Mountain peak in the world.**
 
• **The Aravali Range **located in** Rajasthan India is one of the oldest mountain range of the world**
 
• **Colonel Ranveer Jamwal is ** first **Indian to summit the seven highest mountains in the world in 2019.**
